Its formidable weight and uneven balancing make it a slow, inefficient weapon.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 3 |durability = 47 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Woodcutter's Axe}} Woodcutter's Axes are great tools for cutting down [[Tree]]s, as they have a hidden property which multiplies their damage sevenfold when used against one. However, their weight makes them slow and inefficient [[Weapon]]s. The [[Old Man]] owns one, and he suggests that [[Link]] take it to defend himself with.{{Cite|If you need a weapon, you can find something better. Many beasts roam the land past this point. You can take my axe with you, if you please. Assuming you can find it.|Old Man|BotW}} They are very common on the [[Great Plateau]], as well as in groves of Trees. Since they are made of metal, Woodcutter's Axes will attract [[Lightning]] when equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They can also be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]], and they will sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_032" |Life = 47 |Power = 3 |SpHitActor = "Tree", "Scaffold", "Signboard" |SpHitRatio = 7.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 8 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 9 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 18 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 4 |BuyingPrice = 24 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Tree Stump Model 2.png|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}A Woodcutter's Axe embedded in a [[Tree Stump]] File:AoC Woodcutter's Axe Model.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}The Woodcutter's Axe ==See Also== {{See Also| * Double Axe * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Axes, Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
